answer: Promotion is logged in signal and pulse recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, and thus a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 11 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the vault. A 312 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
